text:
simon: FYI — during last night's DR exercise a few tenants saw traffic flip but operator UI didn't surface the failure reason.

maria: which indicators were missing? logs? metrics? :thinking:

simon: main problem: the control-plane signaled failover but the edge proxies' lease-swap events weren't indexed. ops UI only showed region-unavailable but no lease-owner change.

aj: do we have trace ids? can we correlate proxy logs with region-controller events?

simon: partial. here's a snippet of what the proxies emit:
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
X-Region-Lease: region-us-east-1;owner=proxy-42;lease-ts=1713502401
X-Proxy-Trace: 7a1f-... 
```
but the control-plane writes lease ownership to kv with a different id namespace.

lee: hmm mismatch sounds like mapping layer. Ops can't answer "was this a controller-initiated swap or a network partition". We need a single canonical event stream.

maria: proposal: surface a 'lease-change' event into the operator timeline + link to the controller trace id. Also add an SLO metric: lease-change-latency and lease-change-conflicts.

aj: +1. Add an alert when lease-change occurs without a corresponding proxy-ack within 10s. That would catch partial failures.

simon: also add a 'region-healthset' tag (available/degraded/unreachable) per tenant in timeline. Make it exportable to prometheus.

lee: think about backward compatibility: proxies can send `X-Region-Lease` today. Controller can add `lease_event_id` to write. Operator UI will join on lease_event_id.

ops-bot: [alert] region-swap detected for tenant:acct-1234 at 2024-04-xxTxx:xx:xxZ — controller-event=evt-9f1b

maria: would like small RFC to scope: 1) wire-level header, 2) controller kv write add lease_event_id, 3) operator timeline join, 4) prometheus metrics + runbook alert.

simon: I'll sketch RFC. suggest owners: simon (controller), aj (proxy), lee (ui), maria (runbooks).

lee: sounds good. Can we get a P0/ P1 list? I think operator timeline + lease_event_id is P0.

aj: I'll add proxy ack logic; quick patch should be <1day to emit ack with event id.

maria: tagging @oncall and @sre — please review runbook change after RFC.

simon: thanks. I'll post RFC link once drafted: https://redwood.internal/rfc/lease-visibility

lee: :thumbsup:

aj: quick QA: if kv write fails, controller should still emit event with reason 'kv-fail' so operators see it.

simon: agreed.

maria: closing loop: timeline visibility + alerting should reduce operator triage time from ~30m to <5m.

lee: great. follow-up sync tomorrow 09:30 PT.
